context: Commercial autonomous email delivery failed despite valid sales actions. The failure was recovered the same day and the transport contract was tightened.
root_cause: The configured Gmail identifier belonged to a different Composio/MCP environment than the server-side Composio API key project.
Direct Composio execution required top-level user/entity identity in addition to connected_account_id.
Provider error serialization collapsed structured errors into [object Object], hiding the actionable root cause.
fix: Require provider-project and active-connection consistency before outbound writes.
Use the current pinned/default direct-execute contract and required top-level user/entity identity.
When server-side Gmail is unavailable but the canonical Gmail connector is available, recover within the same sales-action lineage and write provider message/thread IDs back.
prevention_rules: A recoverable commercial transport/configuration failure is not terminal error.
Never treat an MCP word-id or alias as a raw Composio API connected-account ID without same-project verification.
Never retry after a possible external side effect until provider readback proves whether delivery occurred.
Preserve daily send cap, suppression, cooldown, relationship/consent, dedupe and republish-forbidden during recovery.
LinkedIn DM stays fail-closed unless a true send-DM capability is verified.
evidence: Five original sales actions are status done with verified Gmail provider message/thread IDs.
The sixth action remains prepared for the next valid run because the daily send cap is five.
Brain failure registry, canonical Brain learning and Loop Assurance were updated with the prevention contract.
Growth & Revenue OS automation now includes mandatory transport self-heal.
